offer: Miguel informally approaches Carlos to ask whether the auto tech certificate program is worth pursuing and whether Carlos would consider mentoring him or flagging apprentice-track openings once he has foundational skills. No money changes hands — this is a relationship signal and information request.
why_they_accept: Carlos has 0.78 trust with Miguel and is listed as a colleague. Mentoring a younger worker costs Carlos little — informal advice and occasional encouragement. It also builds loyalty and gives Carlos first pick of a motivated, personally-vetted candidate if his shop ever needs to expand. Carlos likely sees the auto sector pressure too and knows good technicians are hard to find. A motivated 23-year-old asking the right questions is an asset, not an imposition.
